presentation.title: Engineering Excellence: From Commit to Production

textElements.content: Every commit is a decision. Every branch a hypothesis. Every merge a conversation — captured forever in the team's shared memory.
textElements.formattedContent: Every commit is a decision. Every branch a hypothesis. Every merge a conversation — captured forever in the team's shared memory.

textElements.content: One change per commit. Make rollback, review, and bisect feel effortless instead of forensic.
textElements.formattedContent: One change per commit. Make rollback, review, and bisect feel effortless instead of forensic.

textElements.content: Trunk-based flow with short-lived feature branches. Long-running branches quietly become technical debt.

textElements.content: Write commits the next engineer (and future you) will thank you for. Messages explain why, not what.
